bader.name: Bader Al-Khayyal
bader.change: The board meeting has moved forward: I need this in four working days, not five. And the deputy chief executive now also wants to know what slot booking does to the feeder lines.

topics.answer: If it answers the feeder question, that works for me. Put it in writing today.
The board decides whether slot booking goes to all four terminals next quarter. I present the recommendation.
The board papers close in a week, five working days from today.
Average waiting matters, but I will not sign anything if the shipping lines can show it hurt them.
There is a draft that says waiting halved at T2. Someone told me it has problems.
I care about T2 against the others. Feeders are a detail, in my view.
If we extend it and it fails, the lines will complain to the ministry. That is the risk.
I rated the names minor: they do not change the decision. But you are right that they cannot leave the unit.
I thought the diverted calls were few. I did not count them by terminal.
The closures are in the before period only for T2's comparison, so I called it minor.
